tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the Tellashirt catalog (tee and hoodie) with locked retail prices, colors, sizes, size upcharges and print specs.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Register customer artwork (URL or file reference), validate its resolution against the print spec, and screen it against the day-one IP rule. Returns a designId, or a refusal for third-party logos/characters.

tools.name: render_mockup
tools.description: Render a mockup preview of a design on a product/color. The customer MUST approve this mockup before place_order — it is the non-negotiable quality step.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Exact delivered total for a product/size/color: retail price + size upcharge + US shipping + tax estimate, broken out line by line. No charge happens here.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place an order after explicit customer approval. Requires approved, mockupApproved and ipAttested to all be true. Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent (test mode) and a Printful DRAFT order — v1 never confirms a Printful order into production automatically.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Production/shipping state and tracking for a Tellashirt order, from the Printful order.
